folded.object: enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope

spans.text: [3] AR: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ EN: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

folded.id: these|are|the verses of the book and a clear qur'an
folded.subject: These
folded.object: the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an

spans.text: These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
[13] AR: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ EN: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
[15] AR: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ EN: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled.

folded.id: this|is|a path [of return] to me [that is] straight
folded.subject: This
folded.object: a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight

spans.text: [41] AR: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ EN: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

folded.id: thus|do|we insert denial into the hearts of the criminals
folded.subject: Thus
folded.object: We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals

spans.text: [12] AR: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ EN: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.

folded.id: upon you|is|the curse until the day of recompense
folded.subject: upon you
folded.object: the curse until the Day of Recompense

spans.text: [35] AR: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ EN: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

folded.id: we|do|not send down the angels except with truth
folded.subject: We
folded.object: not send down the angels except with truth

spans.text: [8] AR: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ EN: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.

[21] AR: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ EN: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.
[9] AR: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ EN: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.

folded.id: what|is|[the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
folded.subject: what
folded.object: [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

spans.text: [32] AR: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ EN: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

folded.id: when i|have|proportioned him and breathed into him of my [created] soul
folded.subject: when I
folded.object: proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul

spans.text: [29] AR: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ EN: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

folded.id: why|do|you not bring us the angels
folded.subject: Why
folded.object: you not bring us the angels

spans.text: [7] AR: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ EN: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
[31] AR: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ EN: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.
[37] AR: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ EN: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
[34] AR: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ EN: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.

[28] AR: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ EN: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
[25] AR: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ EN: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
